text: To establish something is to start it so that it lasts. Route 66 was established in 1926, when it was made an official road.
A centennial is a 100th birthday. Route 66 turned 100 this year.
Quirky means odd or unusual in a fun way. A giant blue whale by the road is quirky.
Route 66 is a famous road in the United States. It is 2,400 miles long.
Road-trippers are people on a long trip in a car. They stop to see things along the way.
A desert is a very dry place with little rain. Many deserts are hot and sandy.
Chicago is a big city in the state of Illinois.
Illinois is a state in the middle of the United States.
Santa Monica is a city in California, right by the Pacific Ocean.
California is a state on the west coast of the United States.
An anniversary is a day each year that marks something that happened before. A 100th anniversary is 100 years later.
A community is a group of people who live in the same place, like a town.
Native Americans are the first peoples who lived in North America, long before cars or this country's cities.
A trail is a narrow path made by people or animals walking.
Dirt is the soil on the ground. A dirt road is not covered in hard pavement.
Paved means covered with a hard, smooth surface so cars can drive easily.
Tourists are people who travel to visit interesting places.
Sightseeing is traveling to look at interesting places.
A motel is a place along a road where travelers sleep for the night.
An attraction is a place people like to visit, like a zoo or a giant statue.
Historic means important in history, from a long time ago.
Interstate highways are big, fast roads that cross many states. Route 66 is older than most of them.
Rambling means wandering along without hurrying. A rambling ride is a slow, winding trip.
A festival is a big party with fun events that a town holds to celebrate something.
Springfield is a city in the state of Missouri.
Missouri is a state in the middle of the United States.
A kickoff is the start of something, like a big event.
A celebration is a party or event to show you are happy about something.
To promote something is to tell people about it so they will want to come.
Tourism is the business of visitors who travel to see places.
Tulsa is a city in the state of Oklahoma.
Oklahoma is a state in the middle of the United States.
A classic car is a very old car that people take care of because they love it.
A parade is a line of people, cars, or bands moving down a street so everyone can watch.
Identity is what makes a person or place special and different from others.
A prairie is a large flat area covered in grass.
Rugged means rough and wild, not smooth.
A landscape is what the land looks like, such as hills, deserts, or fields.
A commission is a group of people chosen to do a special job.
Roadside means beside the road.
A landmark is a famous place or thing that is easy to spot and know.
Catoosa is a small town in Oklahoma.
The Blue Whale of Catoosa is a giant whale statue. It is a pretend whale, not a real one.
